verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes permission systems for MCP tools (devin-docs-13) and autonomous features like Auto-Fix (devin-docs-20), but there is no documentation of a setting that lets a developer toggle between 'confirm each action' and 'auto-approve all actions' for Devin's own task execution. missing for 10: explicit auto-approve/confirmation toggle documentation, evidence of a per-action approval workflow that can be disabled, any community confirmation of this specific control.
